name: 棒棒糖女孩·仓库体型差对决
desc: 15秒单镜喜剧打斗：昏暗工业仓库里，叼棒棒糖的娇小女性以速度渐变与冲击慢动作放倒涂面壮汉，盖·里奇式节奏配施奈德式定格。
original: Medium wide shot in a dark industrial warehouse, muscular bald man with black tribal face paint and open camouflage tactical vest over bare chest, leather arm bracers, cargo pants with belt buckle — squares off against a petite young woman half his size with messy dark hair and bangs, oversized gray sweatshirt slipping off one shoulder revealing a white strap, dark pleated mini skirt, knee-high black socks, lollipop stick hanging from her lips, the big man swings a massive haymaker — she ducks under it effortlessly and delivers a rapid three-punch combo to the big man's gut, the painted fighter doubles over in shock, she springboards off a metal crate and leaps onto his back wrapping both arms around his neck in a chokehold, the big man spins wildly trying to shake her off, crashing into steel shelving units that collapse in a domino chain, she rides him like a rodeo bull, the big man finally grabs her by the back of her sweatshirt and hurls her across the room — she flips mid-air and lands on her feet sliding backward on the concrete floor, pulls the lollipop from her mouth, grins, charges back in low to the ground weaving between the big man's legs and delivers a devastating uppercut to the groin, the painted fighter's eyes go wide, mouth frozen open, slow-motion knees buckling, she winds up a running punch and leaps into a flying right hook that connects with the jaw sending the big man toppling backward like a felled tree crashing through a stack of wooden pallets, dust cloud erupting on impact, harsh single-source overhead industrial light casting deep dramatic shadows, warm amber tone on skin with cool steel-blue environment, anamorphic 35mm, shallow depth of field, Guy Ritchie speed-ramping with Snyder impact slow-motion Total: 15s / 1 shot / 16:9

zh: 昏暗工业仓库内的中远景。一名肌肉发达的光头男子脸上涂有黑色部落纹样，赤裸胸膛外敞穿迷彩战术背心，手臂佩戴皮革护具，身穿带金属腰带扣的工装裤。他与一名身高只有自己一半的娇小年轻女性对峙。女性留着凌乱深色头发和刘海，宽大的灰色卫衣从一侧肩膀滑落，露出白色肩带，下身穿深色百褶短裙和及膝黑袜，嘴里叼着棒棒糖棍。魁梧男子挥出一记沉重的大摆拳，她轻松俯身躲过，并迅速连续三拳击中男子腹部。面部涂绘的格斗者震惊地弯下身体。她蹬踏金属箱借力起跳，跃到男子背上，双臂缠住他的脖子形成裸绞。男子疯狂旋转试图将她甩下，并撞向钢制货架，使货架如多米诺骨牌般连续倒塌。她像骑着牛仔竞技中的公牛一样牢牢骑在他背上。男子最终抓住她卫衣后侧，将她猛甩过整个房间。她在空中翻转，双脚落地后沿混凝土地面向后滑行。她从嘴里取出棒棒糖，露出笑容，贴近地面再次冲锋，从男子双腿之间穿过，并向其裆部打出毁灭性的上勾拳。面部涂绘的格斗者双眼骤然睁大，嘴巴僵硬张开，双膝在慢动作中逐渐弯曲。她蓄力助跑出拳，跃起打出腾空右勾拳，正中男子下颌。男子像被砍倒的大树一样向后倾倒，撞穿一叠木制托盘，落地冲击掀起大片尘云。使用头顶单一工业光源形成强硬照明和深邃戏剧性阴影；人物皮肤为温暖琥珀色调，环境为冷调钢铁蓝；35mm 变形宽银幕镜头、浅景深，采用盖·里奇式速度渐变与扎克·施奈德式冲击慢动作。 总计：15 秒 / 1 个镜头 / 16:9
